corridor_notes: GEM row = Guilin-Yangshuo-Lipu Branch, officially '广西天然气支线管网项目桂林—阳朔—荔浦天然气支线管道工程' per the row's own (unreachable) fgw.gxzf.gov.cn ref (t2198137), later also referred to as '桂东北天然气环网桂林-阳朔-荔浦段' (Northeast-Guilin gas ring network) in 2022-2023 government/press coverage -- same physical route, developer PipeChina Southwest Oil & Gas Pipeline Co., Nanning Branch. Guangxi Daily (epaper.gxrb.com.cn, 2021-11-15, verified) EIA public-comment notice names Shanggaoqiao Village (上高桥村) and Xiazhuang among affected villages within Guilin, and gives the construction company as the PipeChina Southwest Nanning branch -- consistent with a Linggui District start. General (non-single-URL) reporting breaks the ~100km route down as ~50km in Linggui District, ~32km in Yangshuo County, ~18km in Lipu; GEM's own EndLocation=Lipu with StartLocation left null in the sheet, so Linggui is used as the plotted start here on the strength of the Guangxi Daily notice's Guilin-area village names plus that county-level breakdown. Liuzhou Investment Promotion Bureau's republication of a Guangxi Daily energy-project roundup (tzcjj.liuzhou.gov.cn, 2023-04-07, verified) independently confirms the ring-network project as one of 11 'continuing construction' (续建) oil/gas projects in Guangxi's 2023 plan -- corroborates the pilot's status_review finding that this project is past 'proposed' by 2023 (a status-staleness item, out of scope here), not a route detail.
researcher_notes: GEM's own StartLocation cell is null for this row -- Linggui District is inferred here from independent sourcing (Guangxi Daily's affected-village list + a general county-level length breakdown), not copied from GEM. Recommend a human reviewer confirm Linggui (临桂, not the similarly-named neighboring Lingchuan/灵川) before finalizing -- Linggui is the district explicitly named in the length breakdown and matches the 临政函〔2019〕9号 Lingui District government route/valve-chamber approval referenced in search results (unreachable to verify directly this session, cited only as directional corroboration, not a formal ref in this file).
